content.user_title: Process PDFs from Extraction to Form Filling
content.value_statement: PDF workflows often require several libraries and careful handling of pages, forms, coordinates, and scanned content. This skill provides practical recipes and scripts for PDF extraction, transformation, OCR, creation, and form completion.
actual_capabilities: Reads PDF text, metadata, annotations, and tables with pypdf, pdfplumber, PDF.js, and related libraries.
Creates, merges, splits, rotates, crops, watermarks, encrypts, decrypts, and extracts pages or images.
Runs OCR workflows for scanned PDFs using pdf2image and pytesseract.
Inspects fillable fields and validates field identifiers and allowed values before writing a completed form.
Extracts form structure and coordinates from non-fillable PDFs, then adds positioned text annotations.
Provides Python, JavaScript, and command-line examples for local PDF processing.
limitations: Required Python packages and command-line utilities must already be installed.
OCR accuracy depends on image quality, language data, resolution, and document layout.
Complex forms, unusual fonts, signatures, and dynamic PDF features may require manual review.
Output commands can replace existing files, so users should choose distinct paths and keep source copies.

use_cases.title: Prepare Office Documents
use_cases.description: Combine reports, rotate pages, extract tables, and complete recurring PDF forms.

use_cases.title: Digitize Research Archives
use_cases.description: Convert scanned documents into searchable text and extract structured information for analysis.

use_cases.title: Build PDF Workflows
use_cases.description: Implement local PDF creation, transformation, validation, and batch processing with documented libraries and commands.

prompt_templates.title: Extract PDF Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract all readable text from [input.pdf]. Preserve page boundaries and save it as [output.txt]. Report pages with little or no text.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner text extraction from a digital PDF

prompt_templates.title: Merge PDF Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge [file list] in the listed order into [output.pdf]. Preserve every page and report each source page count before writing the result.
prompt_templates.scenario: Ordered document assembly with a basic validation check

prompt_templates.title: Complete a Fillable Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [form.pdf] for fillable fields. Apply [provided values], validate identifiers and choices, then create [completed.pdf] without changing the source.
prompt_templates.scenario: Validated completion of an interactive PDF form

prompt_templates.title: Fill a Scanned Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [scanned-form.pdf] and derive field coordinates. Validate bounding boxes, add [field values] as annotations, and produce [completed.pdf] with a validation image.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced structure and visual coordinate workflow

output_examples.input: Extract text from quarterly-report.pdf while preserving page boundaries.
output_examples.output: Created quarterly-report.txt with labeled page sections. Pages 7 and 12 contained no extractable text and may require OCR.

output_examples.input: Merge cover.pdf, analysis.pdf, and appendix.pdf in that order.
output_examples.output: Created complete-report.pdf with 48 pages. The source files were preserved and the final page count was verified.

output_examples.input: Fill the supplied application form and validate every field before saving.
output_examples.output: Created completed-application.pdf after validating field identifiers, page assignments, and choice values. A visual review is still recommended.

best_practices: Keep source PDFs unchanged and write results to new, clearly named output files.
Validate page counts, extracted text, form values, and visual placement before delivering the final PDF.
Use structure-based coordinates first, then apply visual estimation only to elements that structure extraction misses.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite the only copy of a source document.
Do not assume a scanned PDF contains extractable text before checking or applying OCR.
Do not fill form fields without validating identifiers, page numbers, allowed choices, and final visual placement.

faq.question: Does this skill upload PDF files?
faq.answer: No. The included examples and scripts process files locally and contain no network requests.

faq.question: Which dependencies are required?
faq.answer: Dependencies vary by task and may include pypdf, pdfplumber, ReportLab, pdf2image, pytesseract, Poppler, qpdf, pdftk, ImageMagick, or JavaScript PDF libraries.

faq.question: Can it process scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents image conversion and OCR workflows, but accuracy depends on scan quality and installed language data.

faq.question: Can it fill both interactive and flat forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It validates interactive fields and supports positioned annotations for non-fillable forms using extracted or visually estimated coordinates.

faq.question: Will it preserve the original PDF?
faq.answer: The examples use separate output files, but output paths can overwrite existing files. Keep a source copy and choose a new destination.

faq.question: Can it remove or add PDF passwords?
faq.answer: It documents password protection and decryption with a supplied password. It does not recover unknown passwords or create cryptographic digital signatures.
